_doc: The town's small animals (story 12.5, services/critterLogic.js, entities/Critters.js): the map objects `critter` (kind pigeon, cat or duck). Pigeons peck on the plazas and scatter when a kid or a fast vehicle comes within scatterRadius px, flying up and away (fleeSpeed px/s, maxLift px high) and returning after returnSeconds; cats sit on fences and run off the same way; ducks swim about (swim px) and gather at a kid who feeds them (interact within feedRadius px of the pond, one feeding rests for feedCooldown s). They are only pictures: no body, so no tool, vehicle or slingshot can ever hit them. Texts: critter.feed.
